title: Juicy Crispy American Tofu Skillet
description: A pungent and crispy one-pot American dish featuring dill and marinated tofu, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped dill, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the marinara sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the skillet and cook until the sauce has thickened and the tofu is coated, about 5 minutes.
Serve the tofu hot, garnished with additional chopped dill if desired.
